name: Slider
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site slider sections: Zoom (a full-width row of slide-type cards with the current one centred and larger, for showing new slide types under a hero) and Card (three captioned photo cards in the content width, for use cases). Layouts follow the Framer templates Slider Studio Zoom and CMS Slider Pro; layout only, no Framer image, colour or pixel value.
highlights: Two layouts, each with its own labelled preview and paste-and-run snippet

Zoom: tall 3:4 slide-type cards in a plain image slot with the marketing radius (no Vivid Pink frame, an exception to rule W6 for this page only), the current card centred at full size and its neighbours at 0.88, looping in both directions; it moves with the arrows, the dots, the arrow keys, a click on a neighbour and a drag or swipe

Image ratio switch on both layouts: 3:4 portrait, 1:1 square, 4:3 and 16:9, one modifier class each (aha-slider--portrait, --square, --landscape, --wide, aspect-ratio only, no new token). Zoom defaults to 3:4 and Card to 4:3; the Zoom card is 28% of the stage wide at 3:4 and 1:1, 40% at 4:3 and 56% at 16:9, and the arrows on Card stay centred on the photo at every ratio

Card: 4:3 photos with a meta line and a linked title under each, three across, two at 991px and one at 767px; the arrows move one card and wrap at either end, the dots move a page, and the track is a native scroll-snap row that also scrolls by touch, drag and the arrow keys

Arrows are <aha-button variant="secondary" icon-only size="md"> with the system-caret-left and system-caret-right icons, overlaid on the outer cards; dots reuse the Carousel dot sizes (16 by 4, current 28 in the brand colour)
No autoplay. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the slides change without the zoom or the smooth scroll
Every image is an pointing at a DS marketing-assets placeholder with alt text; the Zoom screenshot slot and the Card photo fill their box and are cropped to the chosen ratio
Each section is a container-query block stepping down at 991, 767 and 479px, with the website gutter and section padding at each step
layoutsIntro: Each section copies the layout and the motion of one Framer slider template (Slider Studio Zoom, CMS Slider Pro), and nothing else of it: colours, sizes, images and type come from the DS. Class names carry the layout.

layouts.name: Zoom
layouts.summary: A full-width row of tall slide-type cards: the current card is centred at full size, its neighbours peek in at 0.88 and zoom up as they move to the centre. Arrows sit over the neighbours at the page edge, dots below.
layouts.useFor: showing new slide types straight under a hero
